title: BPP feature_info result (DESIGN.md §14.1): advertised explicit feature bundles
description: The Success.result payload for op feature_info. Implementations negotiate explicit feature bundles; a feature is advertised only when all of its operations, states, limits, authorization checks, crash semantics, and conformance fixtures are implemented (§14.1) — so each advertised feature names its operations. DESIGN.md §14 does not enumerate these result fields; they are the minimal design-derived set and freeze with the bundle registry.

feature.description: Feature-bundle id, e.g. a frozen spec bundle such as b0.1.
